limits.authority: evaluation-only; no production association or projection is changed
limits.direct_dimension: only observed direct member admission is projected
limits.historical_origin: v1.1 artifacts without raw evidence are marked partial/unobserved
limits.semantic_resolution: no LLM or semantic model is used; grounded semantic policy remains unexplored

policies.canonical_token_unique: accept a full authored identifier token only when it occurs in the candidate qualified name and uniquely resolves among changed symbols
policies.current: reproduce observed direct membership; no policy change
policies.low_fanout: accept only a full identifier with canonical origin and focus fanout one
policies.no_suffix: accept exact identifiers only when the authored term is not suffix-only
